description: A shell script for testing Git reflog display and formatting routines. It includes setup, various test cases for different formatting options of 'git log' and 'git reflog', and checks for output correctness.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands and checks for successful execution.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the actual output with the expected output.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the clock or state in the test environment to simulate passage of time.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or modifies configuration for testing, such as 'log.date raw'.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
